findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: A few cartons of milks were stored overnight in the standing cooler that wasn't functioning properly. Milk cartons were discarded. See violation #33 for further details. Be sure that TCS food items stored in cold holding units are maintained at 41F or less to ensure proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: The 2 door standing cooler in the kitchen area was observed with an ambient temperature of 59F. The temperature gauge on the outside of the cooler read 60F. Items such as but not limited to cheese quesadillas, salsa, lettuce, and fruit were recently placed inside the unit. The items were pulled from the unit and placed into the walk in cooler. Food items stored in the cooler overnight were discarded (cartons of milks). Maintenance was contacted to service the cooler. After servicing the cooler, a probe thermometer placed inside of the unit read 40F, correcting the violation. Ensure that cold holding equipment is sufficient enough to maintain proper cold holding temperatures of 41F or less.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Employee health documents could not be located at the time of inspection. Employee health documents were provided and discussed. Reporting agreements were signed by staff during inspection. Ensure all staff are educated on employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 Sani-bucket was not yet setup and available for use at the start of lunch prep. Bleach solution was provided during inspection. Ensure bleach solution is setup before beginning prep each day and maintained throughout daily operations.
Sanitizer shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the dish machine to have a utensil surface temperature of 147F. The dish machine must achieve a utensil surface temperature of at least 160F. The manager stated that she will call the dish machine company to service the machine. The 3 part sink will be used to sanitize dishes until the machine is serviced. A follow-up will be conducted on 9/12/22 to check the dish machine since the establishment is not in operation for the next three days.

4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed a slotted spoon to have some chips around the edges. The spoon was discarded. Take care to watch for these thing and discard when observed. 750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleansable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed cardboard to be used in the walk in cooler as a tray under chicken base containers. Remove material that can not be washed and replace with sheet pan or other washable material.  750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed cardboard being used to hold the metal cabinet near the walk in freezer up. Remove cardboard and replace with something that is smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable. 2) Observed the shelves in the walk in cooler where they put cans to cool before opening to have chipped paint. Repair or repaint shelves over the summer so that shelves are smooth and easily cleanable. 3) The bottom shelf on the prep table has a small area with rust. They store a pan on top of this area to protect the bowls stored on the shelf. Remove rust over the summer.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observe a scoop in a small container of salt to have the handle in contact with the salt. Scoop was removed and will no longer be stored in the salt. A new scoop will be used anytime salt is retrieved.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 The floor beneath the three compartment sink is soiled and has peeling paint. The attached plumbing is soiled with grease accumulation too. Clean the copper and pvc pipes and reseal the floor so all surfaces beneath the 3-part sink are smooth, easily cleanable and clean. All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
